evidence.claim: Pre-announcement drift exists for some releases (JFQA)
evidence.number: 9 of 20; about 40% of the move; starts about 30 min early
evidence.quote: "Nine of the 20 announcements that move markets show evidence of substantial informed trading before the official release time. Prices begin to move in the 'correct' direction approximately 30 minutes before the release time. The preannouncement price drift accounts on average for approximately 40% of the total price adjustment."
evidence.source: Kurov, Sancetta, Strasser, Wolfe, JFQA 54(1) 2019 449-479, doi 10.1017/S0022109018000625 (RePEc abstract page)
